verdict.rationale: Sill's docs say each iPhone or iPad pairs with the Mac once. After that, only paired devices can connect (encrypted), and Remote Access works away from home via VPN or a forwarded port. That implies later connections need no one at the host to accept them, but the docs never explicitly call this unattended access. missing for 10: explicit statement that connections need no host-side acceptance, admin-provisioned credentials or pre-configured access without the one-time pairing step, evidence of access at the login screen or after reboot, independent corroboration.
